done_when: Every pytest command in .github/workflows/forge-next.yml and the generated forge.yml adds pytest-timeout with --timeout=150 --timeout-method=thread, so a hung test fails by name with its stack in the log before the job cap; nothing else in the workflows changes
why: A test sometimes hangs in Windows test group 1 until the 5-minute job cap cancels the job, and a cancelled job keeps no log, so nobody can see which test hangs
